stem.text: When heated with chlorine, the hydrocarbon 2,2-dimethylbutane undergoes free radical substitution.
In a propagation step a free radical $\text{X}^{\bullet}$ is formed.

stem.alt: Equation: CH3CH2C(CH3)2CH3 + Cl• → X• + HCl, with 2,2-dimethylbutane drawn with a CH3 group above and another below the central carbon

stem.text: How many different structures of $\text{X}^{\bullet}$ are possible?
